description: Search the coins and networks that can be exchanged (by ticker or name, e.g. "usdt", "monero"). Returns code + network pairs to use in the other tools, whether the coin can be sent and/or received, and its USD price. Cheap: served from memory.

query.description: Ticker or coin name; empty lists the biggest coins.

side.description: Only coins that can be sent (from) or received (to).

name: search_assets
title: Find coins and networks
